primary_users: developers choosing a model/runtime configuration for a workload and device
primary_jobs: choose a use case and find the best evidence-backed model + quantization + configuration for this device
manually test one served model/configuration against a representative scenario
understand what each benchmark contains, including test cases, prompts/inputs, expected outputs and evaluator rules
trace aggregate benchmark results down to the individual samples and evaluator evidence that produced them
compare the same benchmark case across model + quantization + configuration candidates
understand quality, runtime and resource evidence without conflating the dimensions
compare compatible evidence and understand model/configuration trade-offs
detect regressions against an explicit compatible baseline

information_architecture.primary_user_question: Which model works best for my workload on this device, and with which configuration?

journey_hierarchy.primary: Find best setup: use case -> models -> configuration search -> campaign -> results
journey_hierarchy.direct_manual: Test a model: model -> scenario -> test -> review -> run result
journey_hierarchy.benchmark_first: Library -> test suite -> benchmark detail -> benchmark case
journey_hierarchy.run_first: Runs -> run detail -> samples -> sample evidence detail
journey_hierarchy.campaign_first: Find best setup -> campaign results -> benchmark case -> compare case across candidates

evidence_drilldown.aggregate_to_sample: aggregate metric -> contributing benchmark cases -> individual sample outcome -> evaluator evidence
evidence_drilldown.benchmark_definition: test suite -> benchmark cases -> prompt/input/context -> expected output -> evaluator rules
evidence_drilldown.cross_candidate: benchmark case -> candidate model + quantization + configuration -> response/outcome/metrics

configuration_search.request_parameters: eligible when supported by the adapter/runtime contract
configuration_search.runtime_load_parameters: eligible only when the serving runtime exposes an explicit mutable configuration lifecycle

evidence_inspection.goal: Every aggregate result must be traceable, when retained evidence permits it, to the benchmark cases that produced it and to evaluator-owned evidence explaining each sample outcome.

case_detail: rendered prompt or canonical input when disclosure is permitted

sample_detail: expected output or gold label when available
evaluator-owned rationale or rule evidence when available
latency and token evidence with provenance

cross_candidate_case_comparison.comparison_key: same benchmark case identity under compatible benchmark/evaluator protocol
candidate_fields: resource evidence only when sample-level attribution is trustworthy
cross_candidate_case_comparison.recommendation_reasoning: must derive from explicit comparable evidence and the versioned decision policy; no post-hoc frontend explanation

aggregate-safe.prompt_and_output_content: not retained unless the evaluator contract requires it
aggregate-safe.sample_metrics_and_typed_outcomes: may remain available when stored as aggregate-safe evidence

evidence-rich.prompt_and_output_content: may be retained explicitly for debugging

progressive_disclosure.essential: sample outcome, main evaluator result, key latency/performance facts
progressive_disclosure.contextual: expected vs actual, per-field/per-rule evaluator breakdown
progressive_disclosure.advanced: full prompt/context, complete response, benchmark/evaluator provenance
progressive_disclosure.expert_diagnostics: raw artifacts/logs only when explicitly retained and safe to expose

critical_journeys.name: Choose use case -> select model candidates -> search configurations -> run campaign -> understand best-fit result
Connect a model -> test it manually -> understand the result
Find tested-model evidence with workload and device context
Compare two compatible runs -> understand trade-offs
Attempt incompatible comparison -> understand why deltas are invalid
Run fails -> understand cause -> retry successfully
Cancel a run -> resources release -> next run succeeds
Inspect a benchmark -> understand its cases, expected outputs and evaluator rules
Open an aggregate run result -> inspect contributing samples -> understand one sample outcome from evaluator evidence
Open a campaign result -> inspect one benchmark case across compatible candidates -> understand response and metric trade-offs

validation.accessibility_automation: planned with browser UI: Playwright + accessibility assertions
validation.visual_regression: planned for stable high-value reference surfaces after implementation
validation.manual_accessibility: keyboard/focus/contrast review at compact, standard and wide desktop sizes
validation.usability_evidence: representative-user review before reference-grade UI claim
validation.sample_traceability: when implemented, verify aggregate -> sample -> evaluator-evidence navigation and aggregate-safe/content-not-retained states
validation.cross_candidate_case_comparison: when implemented, verify same-case identity and comparability before candidate-level response/metric comparison
